task: Read English text aloud in a chosen voice and at a chosen speed
packaging_note: The pinned model and its American and British English voices run offline on CPU.

inputs.what: English text in a UTF-8 text file

outputs.what: a spoken recording of your text

known_issues: English text only. Voice IDs beginning with a use American pronunciation and those beginning with b use British pronunciation. The first download includes the model and voices.

settings.name: VOICE
settings.how: Choose one of the included voices: af_alloy, af_aoede, af_bella, af_heart, af_jessica, af_kore, af_nicole, af_nova, af_river, af_sarah, af_sky, am_adam, am_echo, am_eric, am_fenrir, am_liam, am_michael, am_onyx, am_puck, am_santa, bf_alice, bf_emma, bf_isabella, bf_lily, bm_daniel, bm_fable, bm_george, bm_lewis.

settings.name: SPEED
settings.what: reading speed as a multiplier from 0.5 to 2; default 1
settings.how: Use 0.8 for slower speech or 1.25 for faster speech.
